note: CKEditor5 Fullscreen is a pure UI plugin module: one CKEditor 5 plugin (fullscreen.Fullscreen) contributing a single toolbar button whose Drupal toolbar item id is the literal string 'Fullscreen' (capital F, from ckeditor5_fullscreen.ckeditor5.yml -> drupal.toolbar_items, confirmed by the admin CSS selector .ckeditor5-toolbar-button-Fullscreen). It has no settings form, no configure route (configure=null), no permissions, no Drush, no config schema of its own. Its entire persistent state is that string appearing (or not) in a text format's editor.editor.<format> config entity at settings.toolbar.items. All medium/hard cases are grounded in that real config on namespaced ck5fs_* text formats/editors created for the eval and cleaned up afterward; shared formats (full_html/basic_html) are never touched.

evals.prompt: The Drupal contrib module ckeditor5_fullscreen adds a fullscreen/maximize button to CKEditor 5. I've enabled the module but the button doesn't show up in any text format's toolbar yet. How do I actually add it to a text format's toolbar, and where does that choice get stored in configuration?
evals.expected_output: There is no configure route (configure=null) and no settings form. Go to /admin/config/content/formats/manage/<format> and drag the 'Fullscreen' button from the available buttons into the Active toolbar tray, then Save configuration. The choice is stored in the editor.editor.<format> config entity, in settings.toolbar.items, alongside the format's other CKEditor 5 buttons.

evals.prompt: What is the exact CKEditor 5 toolbar item id that the Drupal module ckeditor5_fullscreen registers for its button? I need the precise string as it would appear in a text format's toolbar items list (e.g. next to 'bold' or 'italic').
evals.expected_output: The toolbar item id is exactly 'Fullscreen' (capital F), as declared under drupal.toolbar_items in ckeditor5_fullscreen.ckeditor5.yml. It appears verbatim in editor.editor.<format> settings.toolbar.items, e.g. ['bold', 'italic', 'Fullscreen'].

evals.prompt: In practical terms, what happens when an editor clicks the 'Fullscreen' button that the ckeditor5_fullscreen module adds to CKEditor 5? Does it change any stored content or filter output?
evals.expected_output: Clicking it toggles a data-fullscreen attribute on the editor's DOM wrapper and on <body>; shipped CSS then positions the editor as a fixed, full-viewport overlay and hides Drupal's displaced toolbars while active. It is purely client-side UI/CSS/JS behavior -- no stored field values, filters, or rendered output are changed.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a text format ck5fs_eval with a CKEditor 5 editor. Inspect the live editor configuration for that format and report whether its toolbar includes the ckeditor5_fullscreen module's Fullscreen button.
evals.expected_output: Yes -- editor.editor.ck5fs_eval has settings.toolbar.items containing 'Fullscreen' (along with 'bold' and 'italic'), so the fullscreen button is present in that format's toolbar.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a text format ck5fs_eval2 with a CKEditor 5 editor. Inspect the live editor configuration for that format and state whether the ckeditor5_fullscreen module's Fullscreen button is present in its toolbar.
evals.expected_output: No -- editor.editor.ck5fs_eval2 settings.toolbar.items is ['bold', 'italic', 'sourceEditing'], which does not contain 'Fullscreen'; the fullscreen button is not enabled on this format.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the text format ck5fs_task has a CKEditor 5 editor whose toolbar currently only has 'bold' and 'italic'. Using the ckeditor5_fullscreen module, add the Fullscreen button to that format's CKEditor 5 toolbar. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: editor.editor.ck5fs_task settings.toolbar.items ends up containing 'Fullscreen' (e.g. append it to the array via drush php:eval and save the Editor entity, or drag the Fullscreen button into the Active toolbar on /admin/config/content/formats/manage/ck5fs_task and Save configuration).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the text format ck5fs_task2 has a CKEditor 5 editor whose toolbar currently has 'heading', 'bold', 'italic', 'link', and 'sourceEditing'. Using the ckeditor5_fullscreen module, add the Fullscreen button to that format's CKEditor 5 toolbar, keeping the existing buttons. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: editor.editor.ck5fs_task2 settings.toolbar.items ends up containing 'Fullscreen' alongside the pre-existing 'heading', 'bold', 'italic', 'link', 'sourceEditing' items (append and save, or drag Fullscreen into the Active toolbar on /admin/config/content/formats/manage/ck5fs_task2 and Save configuration).
